jobs.title: Chief of Staff
jobs.description:
Profound is the fastest-growing AI marketing platform, used by 15% of the Fortune 500 including Comcast, Estée Lauder, and Walmart, and innovators like Ramp, MongoDB, and Figma. It is where marketing teams do the work: research, briefs, content, campaigns, reporting, all in one place, alongside agents that carry the load with them.  

Built on 2B+ real user prompts and growing, Profound’s data shows you what people ask AI and what the models say back. Profound's AI Marketer joins that data with deep context about our customers to find the opportunities worth acting on, and then puts agents to work: automating reporting, drafting content, auditing pages for readability, running competitive research. It measures what works and gets better every day.

As our Chief of Staff, you will act as a force multiplier for the leadership team, driving alignment, ensuring execution, and creating leverage across the business. This role is for someone who is hungry and has exceptionally high agency. You should thrive on ambiguity, take ownership, and know how to create value without waiting for direction. No task is too big or too small.




WHAT YOU’LL DO

 - Partner with the CEO and leadership team to prioritize, execute, and track progress on the highest-impact strategic initiatives across the company

 - Streamline decision-making, manage leadership cadences, and ensure follow-through on commitments to create leverage for leadership

 - Work cross-functionally across Product, Engineering, Growth, and Customer Success to close gaps, accelerate progress, and unlock new opportunities

 - Build trust and alignment across teams to enable collaboration without relying on formal reporting lines

 - Step into ambiguous, high-priority efforts such as launching new processes, tackling operational bottlenecks, or testing new growth levers

 - Provide strategic input, surface insights, and help shape the future direction of Profound




WHO YOU ARE

 - Hungry and high-agency operator, ambitious, driven, and proactive, seeing gaps and filling them without waiting for permission

 - Experienced owner with a background as a product manager, founder, or early operator, owning outcomes end to end

 - Collaborative leader skilled at influencing and driving alignment across teams without formal authority

 - Strategic and tactical, equally comfortable thinking big picture and diving into execution details, with no task too big or too small

 - Resilient and resourceful, thriving in ambiguity, adapting quickly, and biasing toward action




LOCATION

This is an on-site role based in our Union Square, NYC office, designed for builders who thrive on speed, iteration, and meaningful impact.

It is where marketing teams do the work: research, briefs, content, campaigns, reporting, all in one place, alongside agents that carry the load with them.  

Built on 2B+ real user prompts and growing, Profound’s data shows you what people ask AI and what the models say back. Profound's AI Marketer joins that data with deep context about our customers to find the opportunities worth acting on, and then puts agents to work: automating reporting, drafting content, auditing pages for readability, running competitive research. It measures what works and gets better every day.


ABOUT THE ROLE

We're looking for an exceptional People Partner to support our growing Go-to-Market organization, including Sales, Customer Success, Marketing, and GTM Operations, out of our NYC office. This is a high-visibility, cross-functional role: you'll work closely with GTM leadership to build the people strategy, programs, and policies that let the org scale sustainably, not just maintain what already exists.

You'll act as a trusted advisor and thought partner to managers and employees across the full HR lifecycle, including employee relations, performance management, org design, coaching, and program design, while partnering closely with specialist teams (Compensation, Benefits, People Ops, Legal, Talent Acquisition) so the GTM org has the support it needs.

This role suits someone who sees ambiguity as an opportunity to build rather than an obstacle, and who's energized by working shoulder to shoulder with commercial leaders in a fast-moving environment.


WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Partner with GTM leadership to translate business priorities into people strategies: org design, workforce planning, and talent development.

 - Act as the primary HR point of contact for GTM employees and managers, providing guidance on performance management, employee relations, coaching, and policy interpretation, and conducting investigations when issues arise.

 - Lead and support core HR cycles for your client group: performance reviews, compensation planning, promotion cycles, and engagement surveys.

 - Analyze people data and GTM-specific metrics (attrition, ramp time, quota attainment correlation, etc.) to identify trends and recommend proactive interventions.

 - Partner with Talent Acquisition on headcount planning, role scoping, and hiring strategy for GTM roles.

 - Support org changes, promotions, and role transitions specific to sales/GTM compensation structures (e.g., commission plans, quota-carrying roles).

 - Drive change management and communication for company-wide People initiatives within the GTM org.

 - Coach and develop frontline and senior GTM managers on leadership and people management skills.


WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

 - 5+ years of HR experience, with at least 2+ years supporting a Sales, Marketing, or broader GTM/commercial client group (experience with sales compensation structures is a strong plus).

 - Proven experience as an HRBP or similar strategic HR role, ideally in a high-growth, fast-paced environment (SaaS/tech background preferred).

 - Strong understanding of employee relations, performance management, and organizational design principles.

 - Comfort with data: able to build and interpret people analytics/dashboards and use them to influence decisions.

 - Excellent judgment and discretion when handling sensitive and confidential matters.

 - Strong communication and relationship-building skills; able to credibly influence senior commercial leaders.

 - Working knowledge of NY State and NYC employment law.

 - Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience.


LOCATION

This is an on-site role based in our NYC office, designed for builders who thrive on speed, iteration, and meaningful impact.

For this role, the expected base salary range is $200,000 to $250,000. Profound’s total compensation package is designed to be competitive and includes base salary, equity, and a full range of benefits and perks. Final compensation will depend on factors such as your skills, experience, qualifications, and location, and will be determined during the interview process. Our recruiting team will share more details about the full compensation package and benefits as you move through hiring.

#LI-PRO

Note: All official communication from Profound will come from a @tryprofound.com email address. If you're contacted by anyone using a different domain, please disregard and report it as spam.

ABOUT THE ROLE

We're looking for an Associate People Partner to provide broad-ranging HR support out of our London office. Our London team is primarily Go-to-Market, so you'll get the most hands-on exposure to GTM: coaching sales and CS managers, supporting a commission-eligible population, and helping a revenue org scale. But this is a true generalist role: you'll also own broad-ranging HR work across every function in the office, not just GTM, and you'll get exposure to the full employee lifecycle as we build our People function in the UK from the ground up.

You'll work closely with managers and employees on everything from onboarding and policy questions to performance management and employee relations, and you'll partner closely with People Partners across the company (including our GTM-focused partners in the US) to keep programs, policy, and practice consistent across regions.

This role suits someone early in their HR career who wants hands-on, varied experience with a strong tilt toward supporting a commercial team, and the chance to help shape how our People function runs in a new, fast-growing office.


WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Act as the day-to-day point of contact for employees and managers on HR questions across the full employee lifecycle: onboarding, policy interpretation, benefits, and performance management.

 - Support GTM managers and employees most closely, given the London office's Go-to-Market focus, while remaining the go-to HR resource for every team in the office.

 - Support employee relations matters with sound judgment and discretion, escalating and partnering with senior People Partners as needed.

 - Help coordinate and run core HR cycles: performance reviews, compensation planning, and engagement surveys, for the London office.

 - Maintain accurate employee records and HR systems, and help build out People processes and documentation as the London office grows.

 - Support hiring and onboarding logistics in partnership with Talent Acquisition, ensuring new hires have a smooth start.

 - Help ensure compliance with UK employment law and best practices, in consultation with senior People Partners and external counsel as needed.

 - Coach managers on foundational people management skills, including guidance specific to GTM structures like commission plans and quota-carrying roles.

 - Partner closely with People Partners across the company to share context, stay aligned on policy, and bring a London/EMEA perspective into company-wide People programs.

 - Contribute to building a strong, connected culture in the London office as we scale.


WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

 - 3-5 years of HR experience in a generalist capacity, ideally at a fast-paced or high-growth tech company; exposure to a Sales, Customer Success, or other GTM/commercial client group is a strong plus.

 - Solid understanding of UK employment law and HR best practices.

 - Strong communication and interpersonal skills; comfortable being a first point of contact for employees at all levels.

 - Excellent judgment and discretion when handling sensitive and confidential matters.

 - Highly organized, detail-oriented, and comfortable managing multiple priorities in a fast-moving environment.

 - Comfort with HR systems and basic people data/reporting.

 - Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience.




LOCATION

This is an on-site role based in our London office, designed for builders who thrive on speed, iteration, and meaningful impact.

For this role, the expected base salary range is £83,200 - £107,300. Profound’s total compensation package is designed to be competitive and includes base salary, equity, and a full range of benefits and perks.
